# Contributing to the synthetic sandbox

This repository is disposable development data for OpenGH, not a product backlog.

1. Preserve existing fixtures unless intentionally resetting them.
2. Use synthetic, public-safe text and files only.
3. Prefix new reference items with `[Sandbox]` and label them `sandbox-fixture`.
4. Document expected failures, pending checks, and destructive interactions.

- [x] No production credentials required
- [ ] Restore any fixture changed during manual testing

See the [rendering catalogue](../README.md) and [conduct reference](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
